issues: No integrity problems: the diff only changes how starting points are generated, with seeded randomness, no file access and no pasted coordinates.

No bugs that void the result: rounding down leaves at most 3 circles unassigned and they go to random cells, so counts add up to n; every cell is at least 0.35 wide, so the sampling ranges stay valid after the 0.03 margins; the comprehension variable x0 doesn't overwrite anything outside it.
Minor: INIT_LOW is no longer used and should be removed if this idea is kept.

Check: c.ravel() interleaves the x and y values. If _optimise expects all x values followed by all y values, the starting points are no longer the intended 2x2 split. The result would still be valid but the experiment would not test what it claims.

Recomputed z = -0.0060 / (0.0023 * sqrt(1 + 1/2)) = about -2.13, close to the reported -2.146 (the gap is from rounding the inputs). The candidate's sum of radii is lower, so reject is the right decision.
